nodes.text:
Boots off. The deck's dry and I intend to keep it that way.

This was a ship. It's a town now, because it's forty feet up and the water isn't. Bunk, strongbox, and the board where people post what they're selling.

choices.label: How did a ship end up here?

nodes.text:
It didn't end up. It was put. Tidewatch hauled it onto the shelf when they still had the arms for hauling, and they meant it as a watchtower.

Then the Watch went into the water and didn't come out, and their watchtower became my inn. I don't think they'd mind. I don't think they think.

No. That's the part nobody believes.

It rose, it took everything worth taking, and it stopped. It's been at that exact mark for longer than I've been alive. Whatever it wanted, it got.
